The Amala National Book Festival brings together leading national and international publishers, book distributors, technology providers, government agencies, educational institutions, libraries, academicians, researchers and students on a vibrant platform dedicated to learning and intellectual exchange.

Explore an extensive collection of books across general-interest and subject-specific categories, discover emerging educational technologies, engage with institutions and knowledge partners, and experience the timeless joy of reading.

Open to All

Whether you are a student, educator, healthcare professional, researcher, book enthusiast or lifelong learner, the Amala National Book Festival offers something valuable for everyone.

THE PROCESS

Three Rounds of Pure Brilliance.

Collaboration through rigorous literary development. Each round tests a unique facet of knowledge.

ROUND 01

Online Preliminary Round

📅 6th September, 2026 (Sunday) · 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM

⏱️ 30 questions in 30 minutes duration

Online preliminary elimination round to select top qualifying college teams.

ROUND 02

Offline Semi-Final

📅 24th September, 2026 (Thursday) · 9:00 AM onwards

Comprehensive written & stage semi-final prelims held on venue for qualified teams.

ROUND 03

Offline Grand Finale

📅 24th September, 2026 (Thursday) · 12:05 PM onwards

High-stakes live stage grand finale determining the ultimate national quiz champions.

The Top 30 teams from the Online Preliminary Round will qualify to the Offline Semi-Final.

⚡

Only the Top 5 teams qualifying in the Second Round (Offline Semi-Final) shall be eligible to participate in the Third Round (Offline Grand Finale).

GUIDELINES

Know Before You Compete.

Please read all rules carefully. Participation implies acceptance of these official competition guidelines.

VENUE — 2ND & 3RD ROUND

Amala Institute of Medical Sciences, Amala Nagar, Thrissur — 680555

View on Maps↗
ELIGIBILITY01

Age & Institution Criteria

Open to students below 35 years of age from Colleges, Universities and Academic Institutions across India.

TEAM FORMAT02

Preliminary Participation & Team Format

There is no limit for participating in the preliminary round. Each team should consist of 2 members.

STAGES03

Three Stages of Competition

The competition consists of three stages: Online Preliminary, Offline Semi-Final, and Offline Grand Finale.

SEMI-FINALS04

Top 30 Teams Qualification

The Top 30 teams from the Online Preliminary Round will qualify to the Offline Semi-Final.

GRAND FINALE05

Top 5 Teams Finale Stage

Only the Top 5 teams from the Semi-Final shall be eligible to participate in the Grand Finale.

VERIFICATION06

Mandatory Documents

Participants must produce Principal’s Nomination Letter, College ID Card and Aadhar Card for verification in the Semi-Final

GADGET POLICY07

Strict Gadget Prohibition

Mobile phones, smart watches, electronic gadgets, books, notes, and any other unfair means are strictly prohibited during the competition.

DECISIONS08

Quiz Master Authority

The decision of the Quiz Master and Organizing Committee shall be final and binding.

ORGANIZERS09

Schedule & Format Rights

The Organizing Committee reserves the right to modify the schedule, rules, or competition format if necessary.

COMMUNICATION10

Email & Phone Intimation

Selected Teams from Preliminary Round will Intimated through email/Phone

MANDATORY VENUE VERIFICATION

Documents Required at Registration Desk
